question.text: Which of the following statements regarding sulphur is incorrect?

options.text: The vapour at $200^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ consists mostly of $\mathrm{S}_8$ rings
At $600^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ the gas mainly consists of $\mathrm{S}_2$ molecules
The oxidation state of sulphur is never less than $+4$ in its compounds

solution.text:
'S' can exhibit a minimum oxidation state of $-2$ 
(Ex. $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{~S}$ )
